options.content: This dashboard follows a customer from checkout confirmation into order creation, payment, event publishing, inventory updates, and repository writes. Use the Jaeger table below to open a trace for a single checkout, then correlate the custom metrics to see whether slowness is in payment, order persistence, or inventory.

panels.title: Checkout Traces (Jaeger)
panels.description: Searches the shared checkout business span for both standard and one-page checkout flows. Click a TraceID cell to open the detailed Jaeger trace.

panels.title: Checkout Stage P95
panels.description: P95 latency by checkout stage. Payment and order save problems usually show up here first.

panels.title: Business Failures By Stage
panels.description: Business failures that did not necessarily become HTTP 5xx responses.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, failure_category) (((checkout_business_failures_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod",stage!="checkout.place_order"} unless checkout_business_failures_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod",stage="checkout.confirm_order",failure_category!="validation"}) * on (service_instance_id, checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, stage, failure_category) group_left() (topk by (checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, stage, failure_category) (1, timestamp((checkout_business_failures_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod",stage!="checkout.place_order"} unless checkout_business_failures_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod",stage="checkout.confirm_order",failure_category!="validation"}))) > bool 0)))

panels.title: Checkout Outcomes
panels.description: Success versus failure outcomes for checkout confirmation requests.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (checkout_outcomes_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod"} * on (service_instance_id, checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, result) group_left() (topk by (checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, result) (1, timestamp(checkout_outcomes_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod"})) > bool 0))

panels.title: Checkout Error Rate
panels.description: Failure rate derived from checkout outcomes, not from HTTP status alone.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(checkout_outcomes_total{result="failure",checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod"} * on (service_instance_id, checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, result) group_left() (topk by (checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, result) (1, timestamp(checkout_outcomes_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod"})) > bool 0)) / clamp_min(sum(checkout_outcomes_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod"} * on (service_instance_id, checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, result) group_left() (topk by (checkout_variant, payment_method_system_name, is_recurring, result) (1, timestamp(checkout_outcomes_total{checkout_variant=~"$variant",payment_method_system_name=~"$paymentMethod"})) > bool 0)), 0.000001)
